source_anchor: Only the analytic evaluation of the explicit radialized iterated Haar/spatial integral on the right of the first equality in Ex60, through its second equality and the ensuing B6 specialization Eq21. This does NOT identify this integral with H(lambda), prove a Gaussian density law, justify radialization of the original signed mixture, or perform Fubini on the original experiment. Those are separately excluded source obligations.

proposed_signatures.radialized_test_integral:
theorem radialized_test_integral {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : ℝ := (n : ℝ) / 2
    (∀ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => Real.exp (-a O * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4)) volume) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det *
        (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-a O * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4))) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) / (a O) ^ p) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det *
        (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-a O * ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4)) ∂orthogonalHaar n) /
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ p =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ p) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) / (a O) ^ p ∂orthogonalHaar n)

meaning_definitions.orthogonalHaar: Existing concrete full O(n) Borel probability Measure.haarMeasure(top), both determinant signs; its probability/compactness facts are internally proved.
meaning_definitions.EuclideanSpace: Canonical finite real Euclidean space on Fin n and its canonical volume; all powers with real exponent p=n/2 are Real.rpow, not integer division.
